$comment: Execution order for the SQL files in this folder, used by the deploy seed runner
(src/database/seed/seed-runner.ts). Order matters where one seed reads rows another
one inserts. A .sql file that is not listed here still runs — appended after these,
in file-name order, with mode 'always' — so a new independent seed needs no edit here.
mode: 'always' (default) re-runs every deploy; every file below is idempotent.
mode: 'once' runs one time only, while the file's checksum stays unchanged.

seeds.description: fixed.menu_master — the menu tree; runs first because form_section and user_menus reference menus by id
fixed.ui_tables — entry-screen item grid registry; parent of ui_table_columns
fixed.ui_table_columns — item grid layouts; after Ui_Tables.sql (FK) and before the targeted single-column seeds
fixed.grid_details — configured list/report grids and their SQL; parent of grid_columns
fixed.grid_columns — grid column layouts; after Grid_Details.sql (FK)
fixed.dropdown_details — configured lookup popups and their SQL; parent of dropdown_columns
fixed.dropdown_columns — dropdown column layouts; after Dropdown_Details.sql (FK)
fixed.form_section — widget-master tabs; after Menu_Master.sql (FK) and before Item_Master_Widget_Config_Menu29.sql
fixed.form_field — widget-master fields; after Form_Section.sql (FK)
fixed.price_levels — selling price levels
inventory.item_price_levels — price levels sales documents reference (RESTRICT), so ids must match everywhere
inventory.item_gst_units — GST UQC codes; item_unit_master.unit_code is an FK to the code
fixed.stock_adj_reasons — physical stock adjustment reasons (replaces the former TypeScript seed)
fixed.state_codes — GST state codes; sale_quotation/sale_bill/sale_order reference state_code, so they must exist before any sales document can save

accounts.account_groups — the reserved chart of accounts, including the Customers/Suppliers groups the state, city, area and supplier services address by hardcoded id; without it those screens 400 with 'Parent account group does not exist'
accounts.acc_tender_types — payment tender types; referenced by acc_tender_master/detail
accounts.acc_voucher_types — all document series; runs before the three single-type seeds and before Acc_Voucher_Seq_Sale_Bill.sql
fixed.hsn_master — GST HSN/SAC codes
fixed.bank_master — Indian banks
accounts.acc_voucher_types — voucher type 22 (Bil)
accounts.acc_voucher_types — sales order voucher type
accounts.acc_voucher_types — order advance receipt voucher type
accounts.acc_voucher_seq — counter row; joins the voucher type above, plus the company/branch masters, so it must run after them and stays 'always' (it inserts nothing until those rows exist)
fixed.form_section / form_field — item master widget layout
fixed.ui_table_columns — ItemSize column on the quotation item grid
